name: angel-one
display_name: Angel One Connector with Claude AI
description: Trading MCP — live prices, portfolio, holdings and charts from your Angel One account, in plain English.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your Angel One trading account through Angel One's official SmartAPI. Ask for live prices, your holdings and positions, historical candles, position sizing and rule-based screens by typing plain English.

Claude will not place trades on your behalf. Order limits ship at 1 share and Rs 1,000 and are enforced by the server; raise them only deliberately in settings.

Requires an Angel One account, a SmartAPI app with your public IP allowlisted, and TOTP enabled. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Angel One or Anthropic.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: From smartapi.angelone.in — open My Smart API & Apps and click the eye icon beside your app.

client_code.title: Client Code
client_code.description: Your Angel One client code, for example A123456. Found on your Angel One profile.

mpin.title: MPIN
mpin.description: Your Angel One MPIN — NOT your old password. Using the password here is the single most common setup failure.

totp_secret.title: TOTP Secret
totp_secret.description: The long base32 key revealed by 'Can't Scan? Copy the key' at smartapi.angelone.in/enable-totp — NOT the 6-digit code. Check for a trailing space when pasting.

max_order_qty.title: Maximum order quantity
max_order_qty.description: Hard cap on the quantity of any single order. There is no dry-run mode in this server, so this cap is a real safety limit — it cannot be overridden once set. Leave at 1 unless you deliberately intend to place larger orders.

max_order_value.title: Maximum order value (Rs)
max_order_value.description: Hard cap on the rupee value of any single order. Applies only when a price is known; market orders are capped by quantity alone. Leave at 1000 unless you deliberately intend to place larger orders.
